answer: Graduated standing resists sybils: a fresh identity enters with heavily dampened weight and earns full influence only slowly across many honest epochs, so a new seat is near-powerless at first. A swarm spun up together all starts at the bottom of the jetty; none reaches the ivory heights of real influence until each pays real time. Standing accrues like copper patina, slow and earned — mass registration buys only empty, weightless accounts.
